lessons.code:
"""Audit pédagogique : groupes synthétiques indépendants, pas une preuve de biais réel.
Défaut = classe positive 1 dans tout le lab. --fairlearn active l'audit et l'atténuation locaux.
--xgboost ajoute un deuxième modèle local. Aucune décision n'est choisie sur le test.
"""
import argparse
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

def group_metrics(y_true, y_pred, groups):
    y_true, y_pred, groups = (np.asarray(v) for v in (y_true, y_pred, groups))
    if y_true.ndim != 1 or not len(y_true) or y_pred.shape != y_true.shape or groups.shape != y_true.shape:
        raise ValueError("Trois vecteurs alignés non vides sont requis.")
    if not np.isin(y_true, [0, 1]).all() or not np.isin(y_pred, [0, 1]).all() or pd.isna(groups).any():
        raise ValueError("Cibles et prédictions binaires, groupes non manquants requis.")
    rows = []
    for group in np.unique(groups):
        mask = groups == group
        truth, pred = y_true[mask], y_pred[mask]
        tp = int(((truth == 1) & (pred == 1)).sum())
        fp = int(((truth == 0) & (pred == 1)).sum())
        fn = int(((truth == 1) & (pred == 0)).sum())
        tn = int(((truth == 0) & (pred == 0)).sum())
        def ratio(a, b):
            return a / b if b else np.nan
        rows.append({"group": group, "n": len(truth), "TP": tp, "FP": fp, "FN": fn, "TN": tn,
            "prevalence": truth.mean(), "selection_rate": pred.mean(),
            "TPR": ratio(tp, tp+fn), "FPR": ratio(fp, fp+tn),
            "FNR": ratio(fn, tp+fn), "precision": ratio(tp, tp+fp),
            "accuracy": float((truth == pred).mean())})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("group")

def disparity(report, metric):
    values = report[metric]
    if len(values) < 2 or values.isna().any():
        return np.nan
    return float(values.max() - values.min())

def run(include_fairlearn=False, include_xgboost=False):
    X, y = make_classification(n_samples=1500, n_features=10,
        n_informative=6, n_redundant=2, random_state=42)
    groups = np.random.default_rng(42).choice(["A", "B"], size=len(y))
    train_valid, test = train_test_split(np.arange(len(y)), test_size=.25, stratify=y, random_state=42)
    train, valid = train_test_split(train_valid, test_size=.25,
        stratify=y[train_valid], random_state=7)
    estimators = {"Logistique": LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)}
    if include_xgboost:
        from xgboost import XGBClassifier
        estimators["XGBoost"] = XGBClassifier(n_estimators=70, max_depth=3, random_state=42,
                                              eval_metric="logloss", n_jobs=1)
    reports = {}
    for name, estimator in estimators.items():
        model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), estimator).fit(X[train], y[train])
        prediction = model.predict(X[test])
        report = group_metrics(y[test], prediction, groups[test])
        reports[name] = report
        print("\n", name, "\n", report.to_string())
        print("DP difference :", disparity(report, "selection_rate"))
        print("Equal opportunity difference :", disparity(report, "TPR"))
        eo = max(disparity(report, "TPR"), disparity(report, "FPR"))
        print("Equalized odds difference :", eo)
        print("Les NaN représentent des taux non mesurables, pas zéro.")
        if include_fairlearn:
            from fairlearn.metrics import MetricFrame, demographic_parity_difference, equalized_odds_difference
            from fairlearn.postprocessing import ThresholdOptimizer
            frame = MetricFrame(metrics={"accuracy": accuracy_score},
                y_true=y[test], y_pred=prediction, sensitive_features=groups[test])
            print(frame.by_group)
            assert np.isclose(demographic_parity_difference(y[test], prediction,
                sensitive_features=groups[test]), disparity(report, "selection_rate"))
            assert np.isclose(equalized_odds_difference(y[test], prediction,
                sensitive_features=groups[test]), eo)
            # Contraintes ajustées sur validation uniquement ; accès au groupe requis à l'inférence.
            mitigator = ThresholdOptimizer(estimator=model, constraints="equalized_odds",
                objective="balanced_accuracy_score", prefit=True, predict_method="predict_proba")
            mitigator.fit(X[valid], y[valid], sensitive_features=groups[valid])
            mitigated = mitigator.predict(X[test], sensitive_features=groups[test], random_state=42)
            print("Après post-processing (audit test, sans garantie de parité exacte hors validation) :")
            print(group_metrics(y[test], mitigated, groups[test]).to_string())
            print("Accuracy avant/après :", accuracy_score(y[test], prediction), accuracy_score(y[test], mitigated))
    print("\nMODEL CARD — démonstration synthétique, non destinée à décider de crédits.")
    print("Usage : apprendre un audit. Groupe A/B tiré aléatoirement, absent des features.")
    print("Limites : petits groupes, labels artificiels, pas de validation de discrimination réelle.")
    print("À compléter : contexte, dommages possibles, intersections, incertitude, recours, responsable et monitoring.")
    return reports

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--fairlearn", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--xgboost", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    run(args.fairlearn, args.xgboost)

"""Diagnostics sur validation, puis audit final indépendant. --plot et --curves en option.
Les segments et les données sont synthétiques, sans interprétation causale.
"""
import argparse
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification, make_regression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, learning_curve, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, accuracy_score, confusion_matrix

def individual_log_loss(y_true, proba):
    y, p = np.asarray(y_true), np.asarray(proba, dtype=float)
    if y.ndim != 1 or not len(y) or y.shape != p.shape or not np.isin(y, [0, 1]).all():
        raise ValueError("Cibles binaires et probabilités alignées non vides requises.")
    if not np.isfinite(p).all() or np.any((p < 0) | (p > 1)):
        raise ValueError("Probabilités finies dans [0,1] requises.")
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-15, 1-1e-15)
    return -(y*np.log(p)+(1-y)*np.log(1-p))

def segment_report(y_true, proba, segments, threshold=.5):
    losses = individual_log_loss(y_true, proba)
    y, p, segments = np.asarray(y_true), np.asarray(proba), np.asarray(segments)
    if segments.shape != y.shape or pd.isna(segments).any() or not np.isfinite(threshold) or not 0 <= threshold <= 1:
        raise ValueError("Segments alignés non manquants et seuil dans [0,1] requis.")
    pred = (p >= threshold).astype(int)
    frame = pd.DataFrame({"segment": segments, "truth": y, "prediction": pred, "loss": losses})
    rows = []
    for name, group in frame.groupby("segment", observed=True):
        truth, predicted = group["truth"].to_numpy(), group["prediction"].to_numpy()
        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(truth, predicted, labels=[0, 1]).ravel()
        rows.append({"segment": name, "n": len(group), "prevalence": truth.mean(),
            "TP": int(tp), "FP": int(fp), "FN": int(fn), "TN": int(tn),
            "error_rate": float((truth != predicted).mean()), "log_loss": group["loss"].mean(),
            "precision": tp/(tp+fp) if tp+fp else np.nan,
            "recall": tp/(tp+fn) if tp+fn else np.nan})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("segment")

def run(plot=False, curves=False):
    X, y = make_classification(n_samples=1000, n_features=8, n_informative=5, random_state=42)
    dev, test = train_test_split(np.arange(len(y)), test_size=.2, stratify=y, random_state=42)
    train, valid = train_test_split(dev, test_size=.25, stratify=y[dev], random_state=7)
    model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X[train], y[train])
    p = model.predict_proba(X[valid])[:, 1]
    # Bornes apprises sur train. Les doublons sont retirés sans labels qcut incompatibles.
    edges = np.unique(np.quantile(X[train, 0], [1/3, 2/3]))
    segments = pd.cut(X[valid, 0], bins=np.r_[-np.inf, edges, np.inf]).astype(str)
    report = segment_report(y[valid], p, segments)
    print("Diagnostic sur VALIDATION :\n", report.to_string())
    hard = pd.DataFrame({"row_id": valid, "y_true": y[valid], "probability": p,
                         "log_loss": individual_log_loss(y[valid], p)}).sort_values("log_loss", ascending=False).head(10)
    print("Cas difficiles à investiguer, sans suppression automatique :\n", hard.to_string(index=False))
    if curves:
        sizes, train_scores, valid_scores = learning_curve(
            make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)), X[train], y[train],
            cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
            train_sizes=[.3, .6, 1.], scoring="roc_auc", n_jobs=1)
        print(pd.DataFrame({"n": sizes, "train_auc": train_scores.mean(axis=1),
                            "cv_auc": valid_scores.mean(axis=1)}).to_string(index=False))
    # L'audit test n'est pas réutilisé pour choisir seuil ou features.
    test_p = model.predict_proba(X[test])[:, 1]
    print("Audit TEST : AUC =", roc_auc_score(y[test], test_p),
          "accuracy =", accuracy_score(y[test], test_p >= .5))
    if plot:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        plt.hist(individual_log_loss(y[valid], p), bins=20)
        plt.xlabel("Log loss individuelle sur validation")
        plt.show()
        Xr, yr = make_regression(n_samples=300, n_features=3, noise=20, random_state=42)
        a, b = train_test_split(np.arange(len(yr)), test_size=.3, random_state=42)
        predicted = LinearRegression().fit(Xr[a], yr[a]).predict(Xr[b])
        plt.scatter(predicted, yr[b]-predicted, s=10)
        plt.axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
        plt.xlabel("Prédiction"); plt.ylabel("Résidu y − prédiction")
        plt.show()
    return report

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--plot", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--curves", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    run(args.plot, args.curves)

"""Monitoring pédagogique : PSI, KS, JS et absences. --evidently pour le rapport HTML local.
Sans labels, aucune AUC de production ne peut être déduite de ces seuls contrôles.
"""
import argparse
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import ks_2samp
from scipy.spatial.distance import jensenshannon

def calculate_psi(reference, current, bins=10):
    if not isinstance(bins, (int, np.integer)) or isinstance(bins, bool) or bins < 2:
        raise ValueError("bins doit être un entier >= 2.")
    ref, cur = np.asarray(reference, dtype=float), np.asarray(current, dtype=float)
    if ref.ndim != 1 or cur.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Deux vecteurs numériques sont requis.")
    ref, cur = ref[np.isfinite(ref)], cur[np.isfinite(cur)]
    if not len(ref) or not len(cur):
        raise ValueError("Échantillon fini vide.")
    edges = np.unique(np.quantile(ref, np.linspace(0, 1, bins+1)))
    if len(edges) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Référence constante : définir des bins métier explicites.")
    edges[0], edges[-1] = -np.inf, np.inf
    a, _ = np.histogram(ref, bins=edges)
    b, _ = np.histogram(cur, bins=edges)
    # Lissage positif puis normalisation ; les bornes extrêmes conservent toute la masse.
    p = (a+1e-6)/(a.sum()+1e-6*len(a))
    q = (b+1e-6)/(b.sum()+1e-6*len(b))
    return float(np.sum((p-q)*np.log(p/q)))

def monitoring_status(psi, auc_drop, missing_rate):
    values = np.asarray([psi, auc_drop, missing_rate], dtype=float)
    if not np.isfinite(values).all() or psi < 0 or not -1 <= auc_drop <= 1 or not 0 <= missing_rate <= 1:
        raise ValueError("Indicateurs finis ; PSI >= 0, delta AUC dans [-1,1], absences dans [0,1].")
    # auc_drop = AUC référence − AUC courante ; négatif = amélioration.
    statuses = [
        2 if psi > .25 else 1 if psi > .10 else 0,
        2 if auc_drop > .05 else 1 if auc_drop > .02 else 0,
        2 if missing_rate > .10 else 1 if missing_rate > .05 else 0,
    ]
    return ["GREEN", "AMBER", "RED"][max(statuses)]

def run(include_evidently=False):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    reference = pd.DataFrame({"revenu": rng.normal(3000, 700, 800),
        "endettement": rng.normal(35, 10, 800), "anciennete": rng.normal(8, 3, 800)})
    current = pd.DataFrame({"revenu": rng.normal(3800, 800, 800),
        "endettement": rng.normal(42, 12, 800), "anciennete": rng.normal(8, 3, 800)})
    current.loc[:31, "revenu"] = np.nan
    rows = []
    for column in reference:
        a, b = reference[column].dropna().to_numpy(), current[column].dropna().to_numpy()
        statistic, pvalue = ks_2samp(a, b)
        edges = np.unique(np.quantile(a, np.linspace(0, 1, 11)))
        edges[0], edges[-1] = -np.inf, np.inf
        p = np.histogram(a, edges)[0]; q = np.histogram(b, edges)[0]
        rows.append({"variable": column, "PSI": calculate_psi(a, b),
            "KS": statistic, "p_value": pvalue,
            "p_bonferroni": min(1., pvalue*len(reference.columns)),
            # scipy retourne une DISTANCE : carré pour obtenir la divergence.
            "JS_divergence_base2": jensenshannon(p/p.sum(), q/q.sum(), base=2)**2,
            "missing_reference": reference[column].isna().mean(),
            "missing_current": current[column].isna().mean()})
    report = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    print(report.to_string(index=False))
    print("KS significatif ≠ impact métier ; PSI heuristique ≠ test de baisse d'AUC.")
    print("Pas de labels ici : performance et concept drift restent à investiguer.")
    if include_evidently:
        from evidently import Report, Dataset, DataDefinition
        from evidently.presets import DataDriftPreset
        definition = DataDefinition(numerical_columns=list(reference.columns))
        snapshot = Report(metrics=[DataDriftPreset()]).run(
            reference_data=Dataset.from_pandas(reference, data_definition=definition),
            current_data=Dataset.from_pandas(current, data_definition=definition))
        snapshot.save_html("data_drift_report.html")
        print("Rapport local : data_drift_report.html")
    return report

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--evidently", action="store_true")
    run(parser.parse_args().evidently)

"""Bootstrap apparié, McNemar exact, Holm et validation chronologique.
Hypothèse bootstrap : observations i.i.d. Les dépendances demandent d'autres rééchantillonnages.
"""
import argparse
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import binomtest
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, TimeSeriesSplit
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

def _validate(y, *probabilities):
    y = np.asarray(y)
    if y.ndim != 1 or not len(y) or set(np.unique(y)) != {0, 1}:
        raise ValueError("Deux classes binaires et un vecteur non vide sont requis.")
    arrays = []
    for values in probabilities:
        p = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
        if p.shape != y.shape or not np.isfinite(p).all() or np.any((p < 0) | (p > 1)):
            raise ValueError("Probabilités finies alignées dans [0,1] requises.")
        arrays.append(p)
    return (y, *arrays)

def compare_auc_bootstrap(y_true, proba_a, proba_b, n_bootstrap=300, seed=42):
    y, a, b = _validate(y_true, proba_a, proba_b)
    if not isinstance(n_bootstrap, (int, np.integer)) or n_bootstrap < 2:
        raise ValueError("Au moins deux réplications sont requises.")
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    differences = []
    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(len(y), size=len(y), replace=True)
        if len(np.unique(y[idx])) < 2:
            continue
        differences.append(roc_auc_score(y[idx], a[idx]) - roc_auc_score(y[idx], b[idx]))
    if len(differences) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Trop peu de réplications avec deux classes.")
    lower, upper = np.quantile(differences, [.025, .975])
    return {"difference": float(roc_auc_score(y, a)-roc_auc_score(y, b)),
            "lower": float(lower), "upper": float(upper),
            "n_valid": len(differences), "samples": np.asarray(differences)}

def bootstrap_auc(y_true, proba, n_bootstrap=300, seed=42):
    y, p = _validate(y_true, proba)
    # Une prédiction constante a une AUC de 0.5 sur chaque réplication valide.
    result = compare_auc_bootstrap(y, p, np.full(len(y), .5), n_bootstrap, seed)
    return {"auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, p)),
            "lower": result["lower"]+.5, "upper": result["upper"]+.5,
            "n_valid": result["n_valid"]}

def mcnemar_exact(y_true, pred_a, pred_b):
    y, a, b = np.asarray(y_true), np.asarray(pred_a), np.asarray(pred_b)
    if y.ndim != 1 or not len(y) or a.shape != y.shape or b.shape != y.shape:
        raise ValueError("Vecteurs alignés non vides requis.")
    if not all(np.isin(v, [0, 1]).all() for v in (y, a, b)):
        raise ValueError("Labels et prédictions binaires requis.")
    ca, cb = a == y, b == y
    n10, n01 = int((ca & ~cb).sum()), int((~ca & cb).sum())
    p = float(binomtest(n10, n10+n01, .5).pvalue) if n10+n01 else 1.
    return {"n10": n10, "n01": n01, "pvalue": p}

def holm_adjust(pvalues):
    p = np.asarray(pvalues, dtype=float)
    if p.ndim != 1 or not len(p) or not np.isfinite(p).all() or np.any((p < 0) | (p > 1)):
        raise ValueError("Un vecteur non vide de p-values dans [0,1] est requis.")
    order = np.argsort(p)
    adjusted = np.minimum(1., np.maximum.accumulate(p[order] * (len(p)-np.arange(len(p)))))
    result = np.empty(len(p))
    result[order] = adjusted
    return result

def run(plot=False):
    X, y = make_classification(n_samples=750, n_features=8, n_informative=5, random_state=42)
    train, test = train_test_split(np.arange(len(y)), test_size=.3, stratify=y, random_state=42)
    a = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X[train], y[train])
    b = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50, random_state=42, n_jobs=1).fit(X[train], y[train])
    pa, pb = a.predict_proba(X[test])[:, 1], b.predict_proba(X[test])[:, 1]
    print("IC AUC logistique :", bootstrap_auc(y[test], pa))
    comparison = compare_auc_bootstrap(y[test], pa, pb)
    print("Différence AUC logistique − forêt :", {k:v for k,v in comparison.items() if k!="samples"})
    print("McNemar :", mcnemar_exact(y[test], pa>=.5, pb>=.5))
    print("Holm :", holm_adjust([.001, .012, .032, .048, .18]))
    # Démonstration chronologique séparée, générée dans l'ordre du temps.
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    Xt = rng.normal(size=(500, 4))
    yt = (Xt[:, 0] + .3*np.sin(np.arange(500)/50) + rng.normal(size=500) > 0).astype(int)
    rows = []
    for fold, (tr, te) in enumerate(TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=4, gap=5).split(Xt), 1):
        assert tr.max() < te.min()-5
        model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(Xt[tr], yt[tr])
        auc = roc_auc_score(yt[te], model.predict_proba(Xt[te])[:, 1]) if len(np.unique(yt[te]))==2 else np.nan
        rows.append({"fold": fold, "train_end": int(tr.max()), "test_start": int(te.min()), "AUC": auc})
    print("Backtesting chronologique synthétique :\n", pd.DataFrame(rows).to_string(index=False))
    print("Un gap doit correspondre à l'horizon réel des labels. L'IC bootstrap n'inclut pas l'incertitude du réentraînement.")
    if plot:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        plt.hist(comparison["samples"], bins=25)
        plt.axvline(0, color="red")
        plt.xlabel("Différence AUC appariée (logistique − forêt)")
        plt.show()
    return comparison

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--plot", action="store_true")
    run(parser.parse_args().plot)

"""MVP de gouvernance pédagogique : évaluation, règles configurables et Model Card.
Le verdict est un triage technique, jamais une approbation de production.
"""
import math
import json
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import (roc_auc_score, average_precision_score, precision_score,
    recall_score, f1_score, accuracy_score, brier_score_loss, log_loss)

class ClassificationEvaluator:
    def __init__(self, threshold=.5):
        if not np.isfinite(threshold) or not 0 <= threshold <= 1:
            raise ValueError("Seuil dans [0,1] requis.")
        self.threshold = threshold

    def evaluate(self, y_true, y_proba):
        y, p = np.asarray(y_true), np.asarray(y_proba, dtype=float)
        if y.ndim != 1 or not len(y) or p.shape != y.shape or not np.isin(y, [0, 1]).all():
            raise ValueError("Cibles binaires et probabilités alignées non vides requises.")
        if not np.isfinite(p).all() or np.any((p < 0) | (p > 1)):
            raise ValueError("Probabilités finies dans [0,1] requises.")
        pred = (p >= self.threshold).astype(int)
        has_two_classes = len(np.unique(y)) == 2
        return {"n": int(len(y)), "prevalence": float(y.mean()), "threshold": self.threshold,
            "auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, p)) if has_two_classes else None,
            "average_precision": float(average_precision_score(y, p)) if has_two_classes else None,
            "accuracy": float(accuracy_score(y, pred)),
            "precision": float(precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)),
            "recall": float(recall_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)),
            "f1": float(f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)),
            "brier": float(brier_score_loss(y, p)),
            "log_loss": float(log_loss(y, p, labels=[0, 1]))}

DEFAULT_RULES = {"auc": (.80, .70), "brier": (.05, .08), "psi": (.10, .25)}

def evaluate_model(metrics, psi, rules=None, critical_findings=None):
    rules = DEFAULT_RULES if rules is None else rules
    statuses, findings = {}, []
    for name, value in {"auc": metrics.get("auc"), "brier": metrics.get("brier"), "psi": psi}.items():
        if name not in rules or len(rules[name]) != 2:
            raise ValueError("Deux seuils requis pour " + name)
        green, amber = rules[name]
        if not all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(v) for v in (green, amber)):
            raise ValueError("Seuils finis requis.")
        if (name == "auc" and green < amber) or (name != "auc" and green > amber):
            raise ValueError("Ordre des seuils incohérent.")
        valid = isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and not isinstance(value, (bool, np.bool_))
        valid = valid and math.isfinite(float(value)) and value >= 0 and (name == "psi" or value <= 1)
        if not valid:
            statuses[name] = "RED"
            findings.append(name + " absent, non défini ou invalide")
            continue
        if name == "auc":
            status = "GREEN" if value >= green else "AMBER" if value >= amber else "RED"
        else:
            status = "GREEN" if value <= green else "AMBER" if value <= amber else "RED"
        statuses[name] = status
        if status != "GREEN":
            findings.append(name + " : " + status + " selon les seuils pédagogiques")
    if critical_findings:
        statuses["critical_controls"] = "RED"
        findings.extend(str(v) for v in critical_findings)
    rank = {"GREEN": 0, "AMBER": 1, "RED": 2}
    verdict = max(statuses.values(), key=rank.get)
    return {"status": verdict, "criteria": statuses, "findings": findings, "requires_human_review": True}

def run():
    from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
    from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
    from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
    from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
    from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
    from ch05_cours08_solution import calculate_psi
    X, y = make_classification(n_samples=800, n_features=8, n_informative=5, random_state=42)
    train, test = train_test_split(np.arange(len(y)), test_size=.25, stratify=y, random_state=42)
    model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X[train], y[train])
    metrics = ClassificationEvaluator(threshold=.4).evaluate(y[test], model.predict_proba(X[test])[:, 1])
    psi = calculate_psi(X[train, 0], X[test, 0])
    verdict = evaluate_model(metrics, psi)
    card = {"model": "logistique-demo-v1", "dataset": "synthetique-seed42",
        "usage": "Démonstration pédagogique, sans usage de décision de crédit",
        "metrics": metrics, "psi_feature_0": psi, "triage": verdict,
        "not_evaluated": ["SHAP", "robustesse", "fairness", "incertitude conforme", "revue indépendante"],
        "approval": "NON APPROUVÉ POUR LA PRODUCTION",
        "next_steps": ["Compléter les contrôles pertinents", "Revue humaine", "Versionner les artefacts et décisions"]}
    print(json.dumps(card, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
    return card

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
